title: Austin Flood Disaster, New City Manager Hunt
summary:
*   Austin's Mayor formally requested the Governor declare the city a disaster area due to severe Memorial Day flooding.
*   Council advanced the search for a new City Manager, reviewing proposals for an executive recruitment firm.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS.
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Emergency Council Meeting
May 25, 1981
9:30 Α.Μ.
First Floor Conference Room
124 West Eighth Street
The meeting was called to order with Mayor McClellan presiding. Roll Call: Present: Mayor
McClellan, Councilmembers Cooke, Goodman, Himmelblau, Mullen, Urdy, Mayor Pro Tem Trevino
Absent: None
Mayor McClellan said she will send a letter to the Governor of Texas today asking him to
declare Austin a disaster area because of the Memorial Day flooding.
Mayor McClellan next discussed the RFP designed to recruit an executive firm to conduct
the search for a City Manager for Austin. She said Solon Bennett, Director of Purchases
and Stores, is attending the meeting in order to answer any questions concerning the RFP.
Councilmembers then discussed the RFP.
